high_risk_moment: Eligibility and routing check before recruiter review
harm_description: An age or sex rule can prevent an applicant from reaching human consideration, causing opportunity loss that is difficult to detect from the recruiter dashboard.
existing_controls: The public settlement describes post-incident relief, but no control for this product is yet evidenced.
proposed_controls: Disable automatic rejection; prohibit age and sex filters; require a documented job-related reason code and an appeal route for every adverse outcome.
human_oversight: A trained recruiter reviews every proposed adverse outcome with the underlying application evidence; an independent appeal reviewer can reinstate the application; the Product Owner can pause the workflow.
monitoring_metric: Automatic rejection count and selection-rate ratio by monitored group
trigger_threshold: Any automatic rejection, missing review record or selection-rate ratio below 0.80 in a release evaluation
response_action: Immediately pause the workflow, preserve logs, notify the compliance owner and manually re-review affected applications.

harm_description: Historical hiring patterns or gender-correlated resume signals can lower a qualified applicant's ranking and reduce the chance of timely recruiter attention.
existing_controls: The reported experimental tool was scrapped after bias was identified; this pilot has no production performance evidence yet.
proposed_controls: Use only approved job-relevant features; test subgroup recall and near-threshold outcomes before every release; remove or remediate features that create an unexplained disparity.
human_oversight: A recruiter reviews all near-threshold applications and a random sample from each monitored group; an independent reviewer signs the evaluation and may block promotion.
monitoring_metric: Subgroup recall gap and near-threshold review completion rate
trigger_threshold: Subgroup recall gap above 5 percentage points in two consecutive evaluation runs or any missing subgroup evaluation
response_action: Block production promotion, investigate data/features, rerun evaluation and require independent sign-off before resuming.

high_risk_moment: Recruiter shortlist review after recommendation is displayed
harm_description: A recruiter may treat a recommendation score as a final judgment, skip contradictory evidence or fail to inspect applicants placed below the suggested review threshold.
existing_controls: The product is intended as recommendation support, but no evidence yet shows that reviewers understand its limits or use the fallback consistently.
proposed_controls: Display evidence and uncertainty beside every recommendation; prohibit score-only decisions; require reason codes for override and periodic blind review of below-threshold applicants.
human_oversight: The recruiter must record an independent decision rationale and can override the recommendation; a hiring manager audits a sample of decisions and the Responsible AI reviewer can pause the workflow when override patterns indicate rubber-stamping.
monitoring_metric: Override rate, below-threshold sample recall and percentage of decisions with complete rationale
trigger_threshold: More than 90% of decisions follow the recommendation without rationale or below-threshold sample recall falls below the approved baseline
response_action: Pause recommendation display, switch to the manual queue, retrain reviewers and conduct a decision-quality audit before re-enabling.

high_risk_moment: Application ingestion and vendor processing before ranking
harm_description: Unapproved application fields or vendor data flows can expose personal information beyond the job-relevant purpose and reduce an applicant's control over how data is used.
existing_controls: The product boundary identifies vendor-hosted processing, but the final data inventory, retention rule and transfer assessment are not yet approved.
proposed_controls: Minimize inputs to approved job-relevant fields; document vendor access, retention, deletion and transfer controls; prevent ranking from using protected or unrelated attributes.
human_oversight: A privacy reviewer approves the data inventory before pilot; recruiters see only job-relevant evidence; applicants can request correction or appeal through the documented channel; the Product Owner can disable vendor processing.
monitoring_metric: Unapproved-field detection rate and percentage of applications with complete data-flow records
trigger_threshold: Any unapproved field sent to the vendor, missing transfer record or unresolved privacy incident
response_action: Stop ingestion, quarantine affected records, notify privacy response owners, delete or restrict unauthorized copies and reassess the vendor workflow.
